steps.message: Delete the file 2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3 from the Android filesystem located in the Notifications folder within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.

Execute: adb shell "for d in /storage/emulated/0/Notifications /sdcard/Notifications /storage/self/primary/Notifications; do if [ -e \"$d/2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3\" ]; then echo FOUND:$d; fi; done; rm -f /storage/emulated/0/Notifications/2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3 /sdcard/Notifications/2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3 /storage/self/primary/Notifications/2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3; for d in /storage/emulated/0/Notifications /sdcard/Notifications /storage/self/primary/Notifications; do if [ -e \"$d/2023_02_12_proud_apple.mp3\" ]; then echo REMAINS:$d; else echo MISSING:$d; fi; done"
